title: eludite.resx.rename input
description: Rename a key in a resource set, as F2 in the editor's Key column does (proposal 0005): the `name` attribute changes in the neutral file and in every culture file that has the key; nothing else in the files moves. Code that uses the key is not touched: the answer carries the reference count once a scan has run, and eludite.editor.rename on the designer property renames the uses. Class edit_buffer. The designer file is regenerated.

set.description: The resource set: the path of its neutral `.resx` file (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder), or of any of its culture files, which names the same set.

new_key.description: The new name: a name Visual Studio accepts, not already in the set.
